closureStatement: Samsung NE58R9560 induction R1 evidence fits the frozen electric_range rev1 contract without canonical expansion, divergence, or induction-side ontology. surface_heating_system survives inverter/coil/pan-detection architecture; induction hardware remains platform overlay vocabulary. electric_range.json is unchanged. R1 is sufficient for CG-12 closure. Cross-manufacturer matrix remains PENDING — not passed. R2 Whirlpool WFI505 is DEFERRED/OPTIONAL, not a closure prerequisite. Normalization/compounding waits until CG-13 and family boundary review.

crossManufacturerMatrix.auditNote: Matrix deliberately incomplete at closure — R2/R3 were recommended witnesses, not mandatory. PENDING is preserved for audit trail; do not record as passed.

governanceConclusion.statement: CG-12 demonstrates functional compatibility of the frozen electric-range ontology with an induction-range implementation. It does not establish that every induction-specific implementation detail belongs in the canonical ontology, nor does it authorize renaming the ontology. R1 fit does not substitute for cross-manufacturer matrix completion.
